title: Switching Porfile via NSclient V3 doesn't work with APPS 3.0.2.3 and NS 15.02
body:
After creating a new Dataset with new basal rates in NS with profile manager. Switching to this profile in NS is not effected on AAPS 3.0.2.3 app with NSclient V3 enabled unless switching to NSclient V1. 

Example: 
Profile switch in NS at 7:02 was effected in AAPS directly after switching to NSclientV1 at 8:35.

![Screenshot_20240103-091515](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/61501057/5600ec42-1147-4284-8c5d-edb716cfd7c2)
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13816851/AndroidAPS.log)
